[P2] Preserve nonfatal wrapper diagnostics during cleanup

If the final `isShutdown()` query throws `CompletionException(cause)` with a suppressed diagnostic after successful shutdown, this call selects the nonfatal cause without transferring the wrapper's diagnostics. The wrapper is discarded before `DurableExecutor` can normalize it, so those failures become unreachable. Preserve diagnostics from every discarded completion wrapper while retaining application `ExecutionException` identity and cause graphs. Add a nonfatal state-query wrapper regression.
